notes.title: Studio devlog # March 2025
notes.content:
Hello guys,

as time goes on we decided to share some info and our future plans.

[h3]1.Three kingdoms story:Conussia[/h3]

I've received few dozen of comments regarding the bugs and improvements from one of the player, who was kind to study the game and share his point of view. All is fiex, we currently test it.

I still think on releasing the Artbook for this game. We have a number of sketches, though not so many. The game has been released 5 years ago and I don't hope it will attract the new players, but somebody might like it:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/75f49cd768f404c9affbb2d5426e9104e8cb3431.jpg[/img]

[h3]2.The Book of Bondmaids[/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/67b32f932ea4e890a4a4db38a5f9ce9539c00d32.jpg[/img]

We are releasing the Artbook DLC on April 9th.It contains over 100 sketches for you. It'll be released with discount and cost a bit more than one dollar, depending on your country.

[h3]3.Womanizer.[/h3]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/ccc2bf9332cf69138f890454115df3a353abd71c.jpg[/img]

We've implemented the artbook as well, but it's included in the base game.

[h3]4.The Book of Outcasts[/h3]

It's our main project for the moment. 
It's far more complicated than any of our previous work.

We have put a lot of effort into visualizing and describing the world (though it's still a lot of work):

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/e14c2fce6f0e1bb16372206caf54138bb76f3750.jpg[/img]

You will learn more about Conussia and get acquainted with the new realm - Bhardadi:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/6061fd86d7a104272aa18bcca3d3cf98c0f84224.jpg[/img]

So far we have a good progress.

[h3]Our future plans.[/h3]

We still plan to release The Book of Outcasts in May 2025, but we may delay it depending on the results of playtests. As I wrote above, the game is really complex, we have not dealt with such projects before.

If we find a lot of bugs, we'd rather have time to improve the game than release it unfinished.

We're trying to raise awareness. We're going to take every opportunity as an indie studio to promote ourselves - we really need it!

One of the results of this is cross-promotions. We are going to do a few cross-promotions with other developers over the next few months, maybe 2-3 a month. This means you will see other games in our news feed. It can be a little annoying, but it will help us get the game out faster!

We firmly believe that we need to focus all our efforts on developing a truly interesting game and that is enough for success, but at the same time we see that many developers grow precisely through mutual promotion and we cannot ignore this.

Another result was the implementation of the "Promo" section in The Book of Bondmaids and Womanzier. It is a separate option for browsing our other projects.

I am still not sure if it makes sense to add other developers' projects there. If you have a firm "Yes" or "No" to this, please write in the comments. It is another opportunity for promotion, but I have no idea if you will like it.

Regards,
KamtiGames

notes.title: The Book of Outcasts
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38108725/373184cf3a846112371f4e8455168cc7f4cb18cb.png[/img]

Hello guys,

The Book of Outcasts runs directly to it's release state, but it's still a lot of work.

The features we worked on in the last month:

- animated gallery is added
- ape king quest is finished
- sadhika's quest - 50%
- implemented save game points in dungeon 
- implemented fountains points for restoration of health and energy in dungeon (rest points)
- provided shortcuts from Dark and Light forests to the Lich areas in dungeon
- implemented hints system to get to know the game's features more easily
- extended quick notifications system. Now you receive notification when you get the new dossier, art in gallery, key item, etc...
- implemented possibility to choose the text's size in Preferences
- adjusted items info for belts (flasks and scrolls)
- added more content in general (art and music)
- implemented "Show on the map" function for the quests. Now you can click it and see where on the map the quest takes place. It's convenient now.
- added more legend icons to the Map
- writing and plot design provided us with several side quests and a good volume of Bhardadi activities (which we haven't implemented yet)
- improved UI. We added the names of location where you saved your game and a lot of other small stuff
- fixed the bugs reported by patrons

Everything is going well.

We appreciate your support and report about the bugs, also wishlist and comments here on Steam.

We work hard to deliver this game in a good condition on time.

Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849180/The_Book_of_Outcasts/

notes.title: The LAST update
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

It's 2,5 years since The Book of Bondmaids have been released.

It was intereresting journey - delopment itself is reason to write a book about it, a positive book! 
It's a huge community is built up around the game and we've got a lot of questions, feedback from you. Your reports helped us to improve the game and our skills.

We developed two DLC's for the game and you appreciated it.

As story itself is finished, we have nothing to add here, but being grateful for fantastic support from you, we decided to do our last deed for this game - we gathered all reports over the last year and improved the last build of the game as much as it was possible for us, improved localizations, changed the game's engine version, what should fix some issues we were recently struggled with.

And we also would like to share some interesting news for you:

[b]1.We work on the game in the same setting as The Book of Bondmaids. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39199438/45d441f13bff4c7817de6f544070ff6df2bbcb84.jpg[/img]

You'll play again for the guy in Conussia!!! More monsters, more girls, more gameplay and longer story.
You will like it for sure, we have no doubts.
The game's page is not ready yet, we'll establish it within the next months.

[b]2.We release out next project - Womanizer.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461460/Womanizer/

Please look at it, we hope you'll like this game.
As first two games were established in medieval setting, we decided to try something new, that is how this game appeared. 

We stick to our philisophy - developing beautiful 2D games with strong stories.

As soon as we have more news, we'll share with you.
Thanks for staying with us. We are proud of it

Sincerely! 
KamtiGames

notes.title: Current status
notes.content:
Friends and supporters of the Book of Bondmaids!

 

We would like to give you a quick update on the games progress so far.

 

The game is almost entirely complete, with just some additional artworks awaiting implementation. The next step will be rigorously testing the 1.0.0 build to ensure it runs smoothly at launch, and tweaking some elements of gameplay.

 

We had hoped the game would be ready for release by now, but working through the pandemic has been challenging for everyone, including ourselves. All of us here at Kamti Games are working hard to make sure the game released as soon as possible.

 

The Russian and Chinese localizations of the game will hopefully be releasing at the same time as the English language version, with other languages potentially being added later.

 

We thank you for your patience, and will hopefully be announcing a release date soon.

 

Cheers!

 

The Kamti Games team.
